cuts.head: with_body
cuts.ofreeRecent: a hangar maintenance bay — holds her keepsake up beside her face; a modern ferry sundeck with distant harbour cranes in the evening breeze — she takes a quiet weekend crossing and watches a gull-shaped cloud; terraced tea fields on a misty Sichuan hillside — carries a camera by its grip at her side; an old stone chapel lit by candles — holds a small bouquet at chest height; a private far-future orbital apartment with a panoramic window and a hovering circular listening device — she stretches after switching on her favourite music; a Roman marble bath hall — standing; her crew cabin aboard a starship — sitting on the ground; a hilltop lookout over a wide valley — holds a cup in both hands; a penthouse window wall over the city at night — holds a cup in both hands; inside a general's command tent — raises a small red paper lantern beside her face so its glow lights her cheek; a narrow city alley with hanging signboards and wet pavement — carries a camera by its grip at her side; a floating sky garden of hanging vines and flowering terraces above the clouds — lying on her front; a riverside pavilion tower over the Yangtze — holds a gourd-shaped wine flask on a red cord by its cord at chest height
